offer.title: A Message for the Boss
offer.body: You’ve got a message to deliver, Alex. The manager at Saint Agnes wants it passed along to the contact at The Monarch. It’s sealed, and the contents are none of your concern. Just get it there without raising any flags. You can do this the quiet way or make a show of it—your call.
offer.speaker: mara

choices.label: Deliver the package

choices.label: Deliver message at the club
choices.detail: $60 · 75 minutes · +3 respect · +0 heat · At 15 heat, police may stop completion.

choices.label: Hand it off in public
choices.detail: $95 · 30 minutes · +3 respect · +8 heat · At 15 heat, police may stop completion.

offer.outcome: You delivered the sealed package and reported back.

offer.title: A Payment at the Laundry
offer.body: I need you to retrieve a payment left at the Bluebird Laundry. It’s a sealed envelope with a note inside, and I need it back to the person who sent it. This is a quiet matter, and I can’t have any trouble. If you handle it carefully, I’ll make sure you’re well compensated for your time.
